design_philosophy: BRUH ASSISTANT requires a layout that stands out from sterile 'corporate' chat apps. It uses a Neo-Brutalist approach: pastel background blocks, sharp 2px black borders, and hard drop shadows. This makes it incredibly memorable, playful, and distinct, perfectly catering to Gen-Z, students, and casual users without feeling clinical.

layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-80 border-r-2 border-black bg-[#FFFDF9] flex flex-col justify-between
layout_and_spacing.main_chat: flex-1 flex flex-col bg-[#FFFDF9] overflow-hidden relative
layout_and_spacing.chat_bubble_ai: bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-2xl rounded-tl-none p-4 shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] max-w-[85%]
layout_and_spacing.chat_bubble_user: bg-[#1A1A1A] text-white rounded-2xl rounded-tr-none p-4 max-w-[85%] self-end
layout_and_spacing.input_box: w-full rounded-full border-2 border-black p-4 pr-32 text-lg shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] focus:outline-none focus:ring-0
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12 - Generous padding inside all bordered containers to prevent text collision.

motion_and_interaction.bot_switch_animation: framer-motion layoutId for smooth transition between bot modes

components.buttons: px-6 py-3 font-bold rounded-xl border-2 border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all
components.icon_buttons: p-3 rounded-full border-2 border-black bg-white shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all
components.card: bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]
components.badge: px-3 py-1 rounded-full border-2 border-black text-sm font-bold shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]

icons.usage: Use bold stroke widths (2.5 or 3) to match the neo-brutalist aesthetic.

crop_bot_avatar.description: 3D cute robot with a plant growing on top

cook_bot_avatar.description: 3D cute robot wearing a chef hat

healthy_salad_recipe.description: Healthy salad bowl for Cook Bot recipe suggestions

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: Install and configure 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Do NOT use soft drop shadows. Only use hard, offset shadows like 'shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]' everywhere.
The sidebar must be fixed on the left with a hard right border.
The chat input should have floating action buttons inside it for camera, mic, and document upload.
Implement 'Brain of BRUH' as a specialized full-screen overlay or distinct bento-grid view with calculator, timer, and notes.
Ensure the 'Cook Bot' uses the healthy_salad_recipe image when demonstrating recipe suggestions.
Use distinct pastel colors for each bot mode (e.g., bg-[#A0C4FF] for Student, bg-[#CAFFBF] for Crop) on the main chat area background or header to indicate active mode.
Headings must use 'Outfit' font, Body must use 'DM Sans'. Update Google Fonts link in index.html.
Always add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
